premise.logline: Two hospital porters on opposite shifts fall for each other through notes left in a shared locker, and one of them is not who the notes suggest.

modules.theme: whether you can love someone you have only ever read
modules.setting_time: a hard winter of staff shortages
modules.setting_place: a large city hospital, its basements and loading bays
modules.protagonist: a day porter saving to leave the city
modules.protagonist_want: to meet the night porter without ruining it
modules.antagonism: a rota that never lets them overlap, and a supervisor who reads the notes
modules.complication: the notes were started by someone else, as a joke
modules.ending_shape: they meet as themselves and choose each other anyway
